Section 3  Nutrition in the Clinical Setting
Practitioners and registered dietitians should collaborate to optimize nutrition 
­therapy for patients with renal disease. The dietitian should assist in formulating a 
patient specific treatment plan that will provide each individual with the appropriate 
amounts of the aforementioned nutrients. Educational resources for patients and 
professionals are shown in Table 11-10.
